## Purpose
Picks the optional rules for one agent or workflow. Always-on rules show locked; optional rules can be added by hand or suggested by the AI, and each shows who added it and why.

## Responsibilities
- `RuleSelector({value, onChange, suggest})` reads `rulesApi.list`. Suggestions toast "Added N suggested rule(s)".

## Key elements
`RuleSelector`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
None beyond component state.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- Used by the agent page and the create modals.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **Always-on rules are switched off on the Rules page,** not per subject.
- **Targeted rules apply only where a person pointed them,** so they are not pickable here.

## How to rebuild this file
Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.
